doc: Every buff and debuff the game defines (food buffs, Well Rested, Poisoned, Burning, the slows and the shields of spells and potions): how long one lasts and what applying it again does.

ids.game: game:buff_<its 32-bit buff id as 8 hex digits>
ids.mod: (none: a mod adds a buff as a kiln.gamedata clone or a status block)
ids.rule: A game buff has no debug name: its stable name is buff_ and its 32-bit buff id in lower-case hex (the id kiln.gamedata shows, and the one saves and the network carry), so the buff kiln.gamedata calls buff_cdbe9c80 is game:buff_cdbe9c80.

duration.doc: How long the buff lasts when it is applied without a time of its own (an item, an ability or a program that gives one overrides it). The next application takes it; a buff already running keeps its end.

stacking.doc: What applying the buff again does while it runs: keep (the running one stays and the new one is refused), refresh (the running one starts its time again), replace (the running one ends and a new one starts, its effects with it). replaceAtEnd: on this game build the game applies it as replace. A buff in the same place as another buff (a food slot) always replaces it.

kind.doc: Where the buff sits on a character: a food slot, the buffs, the debuffs, the rested slot or the terrain debuff slot.

saved.doc: The buff stays on a character through a save and a load.

entry.removeDoc: Buffs cannot be added or removed through the registry: kiln.gamedata clones and status blocks add buffs.
